sermon.title: Believe and Grow 01/05/2020
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: A New Year message on believing and growing. Noah had faith, did all God commanded and brought his family in. Believers must be planted in God’s house to flourish. The Spirit restores what the locusts ate, fell on Gentiles, filled the upper room and breathed life into dry bones.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Church attendance statistic kept as spoken and not checked.

Indeed, as I looked, the sinews and the flesh came upon them, and the skin covered them over; but there was no breath in them. Also He said to me, “Prophesy to the breath, prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath, ‘Thus says the Lord GOD: “Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe on these slain, that they may live.” ’ ” So I prophesied as He commanded me, and breath came into them, and they lived, and stood upon their feet, an exceedingly great army.
